plays.name: Reserved Bare-Metal H100/H200 Cluster Slicing & Multi-Provider Inference Router Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Commit to wholesale bare-metal or reserved H100/H200/B200 GPU capacity where resale is permitted, then serve isolated multi-tenant quantized vLLM inference and interruptible batch queues through a multi-provider router. Separately resell authorized wholesale SIP and registered 10DLC capacity. Target a 35%–55% net spread after upstream and operating costs; utilization, hardware depreciation, quality requirements and carrier pricing can erase that spread.
inputs: Resale-permitted GPU reservations and approved wholesale telecom agreements with explicit capacity, SLA and acceptable-use terms
Tenant-isolated vLLM inference and provider routing with quantization validation, DCGM metering and protected customer data
Prepaid usage billing, demand commitments and role-appropriate KYC, telecom registration and abuse-response controls
workflow: 1. Validate committed customer demand, benchmark models and negotiate resale-permitted GPU and telecom capacity against conservative utilization forecasts.
2. Configure isolated workloads, licensed models, retention controls and usage metering; establish required telecom registrations and consent controls before activation.
3. Route authorized inference and batch jobs by quality, latency and landed cost while provisioning only vetted, compliant SIP and 10DLC traffic.
4. Reconcile prepaid usage against provider bills, rebalance or reduce commitments when permitted and suspend abusive tenants under documented procedures.
metrics: Net contribution percentage after GPU commitments, carrier costs, bandwidth, support and payment expenses
Billable GPU utilization and inference cost per million tokens at the required quality and latency
Prepaid balance coverage, tenant isolation incidents and telecom abuse complaint rate

platform_risks.failure_mode: Committed capacity remains underused or abusive traffic causes upstream suspension
platform_risks.trigger: Demand shortfall, rapid market price compression, tenant isolation failure or prohibited compute or calling activity
platform_risks.impact: Negative margin, stranded commitments, customer service interruption and regulatory exposure
platform_risks.detection_metric: Utilization below break-even, prepaid balance deficits, isolation alerts and carrier abuse notices
platform_risks.fallback: Suspend abusive workloads, preserve required evidence, route compliant traffic only to authorized alternatives and reduce or renegotiate excess commitments
